$code..write: auth != null && ((!data.exists() && newData.child('host').val() === auth.uid && newData.child('state').val() === 'waiting' && !newData.child('guest').exists() && newData.child('createdAt').val() === now) || (data.exists() && !newData.exists() && data.child('host').val() === auth.uid))

guest..write: auth != null && !data.exists() && newData.val() === auth.uid && data.parent().child('state').val() === 'waiting' && now - data.parent().child('createdAt').val() <= 600000 && (!data.parent().child('invited').exists() || data.parent().child('invited').val() === auth.uid)

turn..write: auth != null && (root.child('rooms').child($code).child('host').val() === auth.uid || root.child('rooms').child($code).child('guest').val() === auth.uid) && (!data.exists() || data.val() === auth.uid)

$move..validate: newData.child('by').val() === auth.uid && newData.child('word').isString() && newData.child('word').val().length >= 2 && newData.child('word').val().length <= 20 && newData.child('at').val() === now

result..validate: (newData.child('winner').val() === newData.parent().child('host').val() || newData.child('winner').val() === newData.parent().child('guest').val()) && newData.child('reason').isString() && newData.child('reason').val().length <= 20 && newData.child('at').val() === now

$uid..validate: newData.hasChildren(['avatar', 'stage', 'at']) && newData.child('avatar').isString() && newData.child('avatar').val().matches(/^[a-z]+_[a-z]+_[a-z]+$/) && newData.child('stage').isNumber() && newData.child('stage').val() >= 1 && newData.child('stage').val() <= 1000 && newData.child('at').val() === now && ((!data.exists() && newData.child('stage').val() <= 10) || (data.exists() && now - data.child('at').val() >= 5000 && newData.child('stage').val() >= data.child('stage').val() && newData.child('stage').val() - data.child('stage').val() <= 20 && newData.child('stage').val() <= data.child('stage').val() + 1 + (now - data.child('at').val()) / 60000))
